visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side contact details (department heading, phone numbers, operating hours, postal/email addresses)

contentPattern.structure: one row with 2-3 cells; each cell holds a bold label or heading, then paragraphs with phone (tel:) or email (mailto:) links and opening hours. Extra rows stack below

usage: Contact and claims pages listing phone lines, operating hours, in-person/post/email channels.
reuseGuidance: Use for text-only contact columns. `image` is for contact columns with small inline icons (for example an envelope before an email link); `alt` is the same layout used on a different section treatment. Use columns-media for image/text splits.
